artworks.title: Edward VI of England
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a young man seated, facing to the right. He has a smooth complexion, full lips, and large eyes. He wears a flat cap, tunic, fur-trimmed cloak, and holds a hilt. He has a pendant around his neck. The portrait is within an oval frame with text and symbols, against a textured background with scrollwork. At the bottom are written details about the subject.

artworks.title: Edward VI
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a young man looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. He has short, light hair and wears a hat with a decorative feather. He has delicate facial features, a confident gaze, and is dressed in a richly detailed outfit with a fur-collared cloak and an embroidered garment beneath. He holds a scepter in his right hand. The portrait is framed by an ornate oval border with text and a coat of arms at the top left corner. The background features intricate engravings and text below the portrait provides details about the person depicted.

artworks.title: Edward VI
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image displays a historical portrait of a young male figure standing upright. He has light hair under a dark cap, a small mouth, and proportionally large eyes. The individual wears an ornate robe with fur trimmings and intricate patterns, along with a detailed undershirt and decorative accessories, including a brooch on his chest. His right hand is near his waist. The background features textured lines and shading, with a Latin inscription at the bottom identifying the subject as "EDVARDVS SEXTVS REX."

artworks.title: Edward VI
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a young man, presenting from the waist up. He is positioned standing, facing the viewer directly, with his right hand over his midsection. The man has youthful facial features with a serious expression and wears a fur-trimmed garment, which includes a richly decorated coat over a patterned doublet. His hair is mostly hidden beneath a flat cap adorned with feathers. Surrounding his outfit is a garment with elaborate embroidery. He holds a pair of gloves in his left hand. No visible jewelry is present. The background features a dark hatch-patterned oval against a lighter backdrop. The bottom of the image has text reading "EDVARDUS SEXTUS REX."

artworks.title: Edward VI
artworks.description: The image shows a person with a bust portrait, displaying the upper torso. The individual faces forward, with their head slightly turned to the side. The person has a smooth, youthful face, large eyes, and a slight smile. They have short, curly hair and wear a detailed outfit with a high ruffled collar and patterned fabric. A crown rests on their head, indicating high status. The background includes a circular frame with text surrounding the image.

artworks.title: Edward, the Black Prince
artworks.description: The image shows an illustrated engraving of a noble person's upper body facing forward with their body turned slightly to the right. The individual has distinct facial features, including a beard and mustache, and long hair flowing from underneath a helmet with a plume. They wear elaborate armor over a patterned garment, with visible layers suggesting opulence and detailed craftsmanship. A fur-lined cloak is draped around their shoulders. The person holds a baton in their right hand. The setting includes an ornate frame with inscriptions and heraldic symbols surrounding the figure, while the background appears plain.

artworks.title: Françoise van Egmond
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up, seated and facing forward. The individual has delicate facial features, a composed expression, and elaborate hair held up with a decorative headpiece and feathers. They are dressed in ornate clothing with a ruffled collar, intricate sleeves, and jewelry, holding a small object and resting one hand on a table with a skull and drapery. The background is plain, framed within an oval border with the name "Damoiselle Franchoyse de Gmont" in a classic engraved style.

artworks.title: Elizabeth

The individual has light-colored hair styled back, and is wearing an elaborately designed garment with a ruffled collar and decorative elements. Their hands are at their waist, and there are no visible jewelry or objects held. The background is simple and textured.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body. The individual is facing slightly to the left with their head turned towards the viewer. The facial features are delicate with a composed expression. The hair is styled elaborately with intricate details, possibly adorned with pearls or jewelry forming a decorative headdress. The clothing looks formal with an ornate dress featuring a large, detailed ruff collar that extends around the neck and shoulders. The dress is also decorated with what appear to be pearls or small gemstones. The person is wearing an embellished necklace. The background is plain. There is a visible border around the portrait with some distressed areas and faint spotting. The text below the image reads "QUEEN ELIZABETH."

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth

The person depicted has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, a small mouth, and hair styled in elaborate curls with a detailed headpiece adorned with pearls. They wear an opulent Elizabethan dress with a wide, lace-trimmed ruff around the neck, intricate patterns, and jeweled details. The person is adorned with jewelry, including a cross necklace, earrings, and other decorative elements. The background is a simple, dark tone, and the name "QUEEN ELIZABETH" is inscribed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is facing slightly to the right, with her head turned towards the front. She has an elongated face, arched eyebrows, and a small mouth. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo adorned with hairpieces or jewels. She wears a decorated gown with a large lace ruff around her neck. The bodice has embellishments resembling jewels, and she has a draped sash. She wears a layered necklace with a pendant, dangling earrings, and holds a scepter in her right hand. The background is dark, contrasting with the intricate details of her attire and features, and the portrait is framed within a border on textured paper.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait showing the upper half of a woman's body, from the waist up. She is sitting or standing straight, facing slightly right with her head turned more towards the viewer. The woman has distinct facial features, a firm gaze, and a composed expression. Her hair is styled back, possibly with a small decorative piece or cap. She wears elaborate clothing, including a high-standing lace collar, a richly patterned dress with puffed sleeves adorned with a lattice design, a large necklace, and a decorative clasp on the bodice. The background is plain, focusing on the subject. The portrait is framed within a speckled border, with text identifying her as "Queen Elizabeth."

artworks.title: Princess Elizabeth
artworks.description: This image is an oval portrait showing the upper body of a person in a forward-facing position. The person has delicate facial features with arched eyebrows, large eyes, and a small, slightly smiling mouth. Their hair is styled in a voluminous manner, swept back to reveal the face. They are wearing an elaborate dress with a high, ornate lace ruff around the neck and intricately patterned fabric on the bodice and sleeves. The clothing features geometric designs and what appears to be embroidery. A piece of jewelry with a pendant can be seen at the neck. The background of the portrait is a simple graduated tone, emphasizing the detailed and rich textures of the clothing and facial features. The entire composition is set within an oval frame, with some texture visible on the surface of the image.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is seated with a calm expression, featuring fair skin, a high forehead, and arched eyebrows. Her hair is in a curly updo with a decorative headpiece. She wears an ornate gown, a ruff around her neck, pearls across her chest, and a pendant necklace. In front of her, two cherubic figures sit on a pedestal with the label "ISABELL." One cherub holds a quill, and the other holds a tablet, with drapery and a decorative frame in the background. Another figure is partially obscured by shadow in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth

Her hair is styled with jeweled pins, and she wears an elaborate ruff around her neck. Her clothing is richly decorated with designs, pearls, and a brooch. An earring is visible on her right ear. The background is plain with an oval frame, and there is a nameplate at the bottom identifying her as Elizabeth, Queen of England and Ireland.

She wears a richly decorated garment, a large lace ruff, multiple strings of pearls as a necklace, and intricate earrings. The background is an oval frame with detailed engravings.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth

artworks.title: Elizabetha Anglia et Francae et Hibe. Reginae(Queen Elizabeth)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman seated in a regal pose. She has a long face, high forehead, serene expression, curly hair with an elaborate headdress, ornate attire, including a dress with a high lace ruff collar and voluminous sleeves. She wears multiple strands of pearls, holds a scepter in her right hand, and a globe with a cross in her left hand. The background features detailed engravings, heraldic emblems, text around the border, and a text block at the bottom.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth

She has distinct facial features and fair complexion, with curly hair styled intricately and adorned with a royal crown. The woman wears an elaborate ruff around her neck and richly detailed attire with patterns, pearls, and jewels. artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth

Her facial features are finely detailed, with a look of regal poise. Her hair is styled elaborately with curls and adorned with pearls and a crown. The queen is wearing a richly decorated gown with intricate patterns and a large, ornate ruff around her neck. She is adorned with multiple strands of pearls, a cross-shaped jewelry piece, pearl earrings, and other elaborate jewelry. The background features an intricate and ornate design pattern.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth

The individual's facial features include high arched eyebrows, a long nose, and small lips, and they have curly hair adorned with an elaborate crown composed of pearls and jewels. They are wearing a highly ornate outfit featuring a large, structured ruff around their neck and a detailed dress embellished with patterns and pearls. The person is adorned with multiple strands of necklaces and earrings. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a seated individual in regal attire holding a closed book and a scepter. They have detailed facial features, an elaborate hairstyle, and wear a high collar and richly patterned gown. A crown is on their head above a halo-like circle, with a royal crest in the upper left corner. A French inscription is at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The artwork shows a three-quarter length portrait of a person seated with a scepter in one hand and a book or decorative item in the other. The person is in an upright position, facing the left side of the image. They have an elaborate hairstyle that is tightly curled and styled upward, adorned with a crown. The facial features are detailed with a calm and composed expression. They are wearing an ornate garment with intricate patterns and puffed sleeves, and a large, ruffled collar surrounds their neck. A bracelet can be seen on the wrist holding the book. The background of the image is plain, with a coat of arms or crest situated in the upper left corner, and there is a text inscription at the bottom of the artwork.
